name: morphing-text

frames.best_why: A single crisp bold word fills the stage, showing the effect in its settled state.

tagline: One bold word blurs and melts into the next.
summary: A large centred word that dissolves through a heavy blur and re-forms as the next phrase in a list, cycling forever without the layout moving.
appearance: A single very large, heavy white sans-serif word sits in the middle of an otherwise empty black canvas. During a transition the word softens into a fat, rounded blob before sharpening into the next word.
behaviour: The current word blurs out while the incoming word sharpens in, the two briefly melting together, then the new word holds for half a second before the cycle repeats down the list.
demo_content: The words Design, Prototype, Iterate, Ship it and Repeat cycle in turn.
search_phrases: words that blur into each other
big text that changes by itself
animated word cycle for a hero
landing title that shifts between phrases
use_when: A hero needs a short list of phrases to cycle in place without shifting the layout.
avoid_when: Long phrases or many messages; big blurred text is hard to follow on a loop.
customise: The phrases are passed as a texts array and size, height and spacing come from the class name; the blur filter and the 1.5s morph and 0.5s hold are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A requestAnimationFrame loop runs nonstop, blurring and fading two text spans every frame.

a11y.note: The rotating words sit in plain spans with no live region, and the endless loop ignores reduced-motion settings.

polish_why: Crisp heavy type and a smooth blur melt; the loop is simple and reads cleanly.
